news.title: Smoky Hollow is on the Mac
news.body: Mac neighbors can grab the launcher from the website's Trading Post. It works on Apple-chip and Intel Macs.

news.title: Skills just got a lot faster
news.body: A sim skilling alone now maxes a skill in about 8 hours, and skill lots and groups are faster still. Press UPDATE in the launcher to get it.

news.title: Smoky Hollow opens for testing
news.body: The first homestead is up on Grindstone Oasis and the jam stand is paying out.

news.title: Town lots that never close
news.body: Public spots run by the town, open to everyone whether anybody lives there or not.

news.title: Neighbors
news.body: Our first testers are moving in soon. Plenty of room by the creek.
